wholePhysicalScope: The four native corners of the present-day named office control the frontage and site envelope. The circa-1910 photo and Queensland register description establish the projecting central gable and raised twin porches. The original rear wall position is estimated.
lodDetails: Four levels preserve the central gable, open twin porches, raised floor and corrugated roof. Closer levels refine porch balusters, shutter framing, lettering and downpipes.
limitations: This represents the original timber office around 1910. The present-day footprint is a broad site control. Historical depth, rear openings, porch lattice details and structural members are approximate.
The photograph is monochrome and partly obscured. Timber, trim and roof colors are estimates. The separate former office used as a residence and later exchange additions are outside this model.
The original public elevation field remains unchanged. Foundation, floor and stair contact are approximate.
